Package com.cdarobotics.cdalib.subsystems

package com.cdarobotics.cdalib.subsystems
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    CompoundSubsystem
    A Subsystem that groups several child subsystems and fans each lifecycle call (init/start/update/stop) out to all of them.
    DeviceSubsystem
    A Subsystem backed by a single Device.
    NullSubsystem
    A Subsystem whose lifecycle methods all do nothing.
    PositionMotorSubsystem
    A Subsystem that drives a single motor toward a target position using a Controller.
    Subsystem
    A robot mechanism with a fixed lifecycle: Subsystem.init() once on OpMode init, Subsystem.start() once when the OpMode starts, Subsystem.update() every loop, and Subsystem.stop() once when it ends.
    ThreadedIMU
    A Subsystem that reads the IMU on its own background thread so the main loop never blocks on it.
